title: wastped
description: Wastped - minecraft mod for forge 1.20.1, Adds a beautiful new dimension and a bit of western
body:
# WastPED - Discover Nova’s Main Secret

WastPED is a Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod that continues the story of MyPED as a direct DLC.

You are thrown into an endlessly hot wasteland filled with harsh desert biomes, abandoned cities, forgotten stations, crashed ships, and western themed locations. Complete NPC quests, follow the main storyline, and uncover Nova’s secret.

The core reason to play WastPED is exploration and survival in a unique atmospheric desert tied directly to the MyPED lore.

---

![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cea0bc2899b9d437140f9a9861869b351d8be7e.png)

---

## Main Features

### Atmosphere and Immersion

* Dynamic desert winds and sandstorms
* Biome music and visual effects
* Floating dialogue system
* Flying Nova crystal planet visible day and night
* Custom animated main menu
* Western inspired world theme

### Exploration and Adventure

* Separate dimension: `wastped:waste`
* Multiple hot biomes: Desert, Mesa, Desert Mesa, Salt Fields, Wasteland, Crystal Desert
* Procedurally generated structures, cities, stations, and abandoned ships
* Rare treasures and Ancient Debris found through exploration, not mining
* No ores in caves. Progression is based on scavenging

### NPCs, Quests, and Story

* NPCs for world life and lore
* Quest driven progression
* Trading and story interactions
* Secret mob and hidden achievement
* Main plot focused on discovering Nova’s mystery

### Survival and Challenge

* Extreme heat mechanics
* Thirst system that weakens attack speed, damage, and movement while increasing hunger
* Limited access to water
* Aggressive desert mobs
* Optional auto spawn in the wasteland dimension

### Gameplay Systems

* Custom dialogue commands and character naming
* Floating animated dialogue window
* Colored character names and messages
* Player nickname visibility toggle
* Gamerule `doAutospawnInWaste`
* Dynamic lighting
* Western themed structures and mobs

---

## Dimension Design

WastPED introduces a fully separate wasteland dimension built for long term survival. You may enable auto spawn and remain there permanently.

Caves exist, but they never contain ores. Progression relies on exploration: searching ruins, stations, ships, and cities for resources and rare loot.

The mod focuses heavily on visuals and atmosphere: winds, storms, biome music, visual effects, and a custom main menu.

---

## Salt Mechanic

Hold food in both hands and use it to apply salt.

Salted food grants:

* Thirst
* Water Breathing
* Regeneration II for 30 minutes

---

## Status Effects

### Thirst

* Reduces attack speed and attack damage
* Slows movement
* Increases hunger rate

Removed by entering water or drinking.

---

## Biomes and IDs

* Mesa
* Desert Mesa
* Salt Field
* Wasteland
* Crystal Desert

Blocks and dimensions:

* `wastped:desert`
* `wastped:waste`
* `wastped:mesa`
